extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorates and staff responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 and preparing the Agency's consolidated reports (e.g., DD/PTOS, DD/IOS, DD/PS, C/SRS, C/SSC, C/A&TS, EPD File)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and procedural requirements for preparing and submitting the Agency's consolidated implementation reports under OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), including which sections to prepare, report formats (narrative/statistical), attachments, distribution, and routing procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare formal agency‑wide implementation instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: A formal Agency-wide implementation instruction should be prepared that consolidates policies, procedures, and guidelines for carrying out the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The instruction should consolidate existing policies/procedures/guidelines and assign Agency responsibilities for program improvement and implementation (text indicates a consolidated Agency-wide document is required).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sections I and II: cover current fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections I and II of the report will cover the current, not the upcoming, fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the detailed instructions for preparing Sections I and II as set out on page 3 of reference (c), but ensure the temporal scope is the current fiscal year. Prepare both statistical and narrative reports where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sections III and IV: follow detailed guidance in reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions concerning the preparation of Sections III and IV are detailed on pages 3 and 4 of reference (c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing Sections III and IV, consult the specified pages of the reference for full details; where possible prepare both narrative and statistical components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare both narrative and statistical reports where possible
rubrics_metrics.description: Both narrative and statistical reports should be prepared for the sections where feasible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memorandum repeatedly instructs that, where possible, both narrative and statistical formats should accompany the submissions to provide qualitative and quantitative information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit required reports by specified deadline (14 December 1970)
rubrics_metrics.description: All Directorates and Staff should submit their reports as required in Section IX (Reference c) to the Division on or before 14 December 1970 so a consolidated office report can be submitted by the due date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely submission is required to allow consolidation. Use the date provided; if questions arise, refer to the designated contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide attachments as stated
rubrics_metrics.description: Include attachments as stated in the memorandum ('Attachments: As Stated Above').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all referenced attachments are included with submissions per the instructions in the memorandum and reference documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer questions to OC Executive and Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Any questions concerning the program can be referred to OC Executive and Plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the designated office (OC Executive and Plans) as the point of contact for clarifications about preparation or submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow specified Division distribution list
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute the report to the listed offices: Orig ? DD/PTOS, DD/IOS, DD/PS, C/SRS, C/A&?S (C/A&TS), C/SSC, EPD File, EPD Chrono, etc., per the Division Distribution listing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the distribution recipients shown in the memorandum to ensure all relevant offices receive copies (each with indicated attachments where noted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official routing slip with classification checks
rubrics_metrics.description: The sender must check classification on top and bottom (UNCLASSIFIED / CONFIDENTIAL / SECRET) on the official routing slip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the routing slip displays the correct classification marking at both top and bottom and use the routing slip fields as provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete routing slip fields and action boxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing slip must include fields such as TO NAME AND ADDRESS, DATE, INITIALS and action boxes (DIRECT REPLY, PREPARE REPLY, APPROVAL, DISPATCH, RECOMMENDATION, COMMENT, FILE, RETURN, CONCURRENCE, INFORMATION), plus signature, remarks, file copy, and deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the routing slip template to indicate required handling steps, responsible individuals (initials), and deadlines; retain or return file copies as specified.
